channel.title: The Great Hokkaido Watershed Traverse: A 670 Kilometer Solo Snowy Journey
channel.desc: A 27-year-old Japanese mountaineer achieved the feat of crossing a watershed that runs across Hokkaido Prefecture. This documentary chronicles his journey as he confronts the harsh nature and examines his life.\nCorrected on Oct 2, 2025: The author's subtitle at 01:40.
